falsifiable_hypothesis: Scalar hierarchical gating treats all 24 targets as equally reliable even though inner-fold deviation estimates have different noise. A targetwise positive-part signal-to-noise reliability, combined with independent common-mode reliability by probabilistic union, can preserve strong target innovations while suppressing noisy ones without a tunable threshold.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: From the same three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors compute theta_global, theta_hier, common reliability a_common, deviation mean d_j and variance-of-mean v_j. Define target reliability r_j=max(0,1-v_j/d_j^2), with zero when d_j^2 is numerically zero. Define w_j=1-(1-r_j)*(1-a_common). Set theta_j=theta_global,j+w_j*(theta_hier,j-theta_global,j), then q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. All quantities are fitting-only and parameter-free.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
